_comment: COVFIX PG's tool and product pins, filled only from the director's confirm of PG's probe receipt (state/2d-closeout/covfix-20261122/pg/PLAN-SLOT1-PROBE.md, R1). pg_generate.sh and pg_replay.sh refuse while any is null or system_tools is empty. system_tools maps each exec'd system tool's real path (awk: the probe's gawk) to its sha256 (RULINGS-A2.md, round 3, D1). compat_libs (the director, 2026-11-26, B3 run 2's exe-check STOP): the compat-lib shim setup_genie_v3.sh puts first on LD_LIBRARY_PATH ($HOME/.genie_compatlibs, as F1), by its real path, and each library GENIE loads from it (B3's NEEDED closure, install/b3-diag/b3-libs.out) with its real target and sha256; exe-check allows the shim only so, trace-check allows each only at that real path, pin-hash hashes each at start and end. libxxhash.so.0's target is in the analysis conda env on the home filesystem, with no revision tracking (ruling (i)). minerva_repo: the libssl/libcrypto targets' CVMFS repository, revision-tracked as larsoft is; its values here are the observed baseline (install/b3-diag/b3-xxhash.out), and each run records its own start and end. interpreter_tools (round 9): {real path: sha256} of the programs ROOT 6.22's interpreter runs under a GENIE program (sh as bash, ls, sed, ldd, both loaders, CVMFS gcc v9_3_0's g++ and cc1plus), from install/b3-diag/b3-interp-pins.out; pg_verify binds each only as a child, in the ROOT roles, with B3 run 3's command lines.
